stdin.source: bash help command: "command [-pVv] command [arg ...]" (-v/-V look a name up and print; no stdin wording, classified "never")

stdout.source: bash help command: "-v print a single word indicating the command or filename that invokes COMMAND; -V print a more verbose description of each COMMAND" (a description of how a name resolves: metadata)

unknownFlag.source: bash help command: full option listing reviewed; an unmodeled or unrecognized flag has no documented-safe model here, so this repo's fail-closed default ("insufficient") applies

citation.source: bash help command: "-V  print a more verbose description of each COMMAND"
bash help command: "-v  print a single word indicating the command or filename that"

bash help command: "command [-pVv] command [arg ...] ... Runs COMMAND with ARGS" (the positional form RUNS the command, so it is unmodeled; the lookup name is consumed as the operand of -v/-V instead)
